cases.title: Full control preserves legal move_on
cases.research_question: Does a complete packet with active and next chunk fields still advance exactly one chunk?

{"protocol":"TTD_COMMAND_V1","command_id":"route_law_minimal_field_ablation_001_full_control","state_version":1,"session_id":"route-law-minimal-field-ablation-v1","route_id":"desk-reset-v0","active_goal":"reset the desk enough to choose the next work item","active_chunk_id":"clear_trash","active_chunk_label":"clear trash","chunk_index":0,"phase":"hold","allowed_intents":["continue","done","move_on","next","pause"],"completion_condition":"trash is gathered and removed from the desk surface","next_chunk_id":"collect_dishes","next_chunk_label":"collect dishes","route_sequence":["clear_trash","collect_dishes","stack_papers","wipe_surface","choose_next"],"commit_policy":"move_on advances exactly one chunk and names the new active chunk","response_contract":["Before Billy replies, say only: Ready for move_on.","After Billy replies move_on, say exactly: New active chunk: collect dishes.","Do not skip chunks or invent completed work."]}

Assistant does not skip to stack_papers.
